_usage: Copy this file to .minecraft/wurst/shopgui.json and customize for your server
_instructions: 1. Enable debug mode in AutoShopGUI settings to see screen titles and slot indices
2. Manually navigate through the shop to find the slot numbers for each step
3. Add the slot numbers to the 'navigation' array in the order you click them
4. Each navigation step has 'slot' (the slot index) and 'click' (left or right)
5. For 'sell' actions, the bot will automatically sell ALL matching items in your inventory
6. Enable the target and run AutoShopGUI

targets._example: Buy a Diamond Sword from the Shop Keeper
Sell ALL Sugar Canes to the farming NPC
targets._quantity_note: For 'sell' action, this field is ignored - it will sell ALL matching items

navigation._note: Click the Sugar Cane sell item slot

targets._sell_behavior: The bot will automatically handle quantity buttons to sell all items

targets._example: Example with right-click (some shops require this)

navigation._note: Some shop GUIs require right-click for certain actions

_tips: Use F3 to check exact NPC names (partial matches work - case-insensitive)
Slot indices start at 0 and go left-to-right, top-to-bottom
Most chest GUIs are 9 slots wide (0-8 is row 1, 9-17 is row 2, etc.)
Enable debug mode to see what slot each item is in
The 'click' field can be 'left' or 'right' - most shops use 'left'
For 'sell' actions: The bot automatically sells ALL items matching 'item_name'
The 'quantity' field is currently only informational for sell actions
Only one target will run per activation (the first enabled one)
The hack will automatically close the GUI after completing the trade
